byPath.*: Originates joint mortgage applications: scores every applicant with a scorecard, applies the knockout rules of the credit policy, prices the loan by risk grade and loan-to-value, and tests affordability before it makes an offer
byPath.Applicant: One borrower of the application: identity, employment, monthly budget and credit bureau data
byPath.ApplicantPolicy: Checks one applicant against the knockout rules and names every failed rule
byPath.ApplicantScore: Scores one applicant with the scorecard and grades the score
byPath.Application: A mortgage application: the loan terms and one or more applicants
byPath.HouseholdRisk: The household score, the score of the weaker applicant, and its risk grade
byPath.LoanDecision: The knockouts of every applicant, the affordability stress test and the APPROVE, REFER or DECLINE verdict
byPath.LoanOffer: The approved amount, rate and payment, or the counter-offer within the affordability and LTV limits
byPath.LoanPricing: The margin for the household risk grade and the loan-to-value, and the offered rate
byPath.LoanTerms: The requested loan: the application date, the amount, the property value and the term in years
byPath.affordability: The monthly payment, the payment stress-tested at the rate plus the buffer, the debt service to income and the largest affordable loan
byPath.applicantScorecard: The application scorecard: every characteristic of the applicant falls into one bin, and each bin gives points
byPath.borrowingCapacity: The largest affordable loan of a household for terms of 10 to 30 years
byPath.capacityBook: How much a household can borrow for each term from 10 to 30 years, from its income, its debt payments and the offered rate
byPath.capacityBook.capacity: The largest affordable payment and loan for each term
byPath.capacityBook.household: The monthly income, the monthly debt payments and the offered rate of the household
byPath.creditPolicy: The parameters of the credit policy: the reference rate, the stress buffer and the limits
byPath.decisionMatrix: Combines the knockouts, the risk grade, the loan-to-value and the debt service into a decision
byPath.jointApplication: Builds an application from the loan terms and two applicants
byPath.loanOriginationDecision: Decides a mortgage application: scores and checks every applicant, prices the loan, tests affordability and makes an offer
byPath.originationBook: A joint mortgage application from the loan terms and two applicants, through both scorecards, to the decision and the offer
byPath.originationBook.application: The application built from the loan terms and both applicants
byPath.originationBook.mainScorecard: The scorecard of the main applicant
byPath.originationBook.origination: The origination decision on the application
byPath.policyRules: The knockout rules of the credit policy, one record per rule
byPath.pricingGrid: The margin over the reference rate for the risk grade and the loan-to-value
byPath.riskGrade: Maps the scorecard points to a risk grade and its probability of default
byPath.sampleDecision: The decision on the example application
